socfpga_ddr_mailbox.h

IOSSM mailbox registers, command codes, and the functions that talk to the IO96B.

Constants
Field helpers

Shift a value into or out of a bit field.

__bf_shf

Shift count of the lowest set bit in x. Computed as __builtin_ffsll(x) - 1.

FIELD_GET

Bits of _reg selected by _mask, shifted down so the field starts at bit 0.

FIELD_PREP

_val shifted up to the position of _mask, then masked with _mask.

Mailbox timeouts and status bits

Poll limits, and bits in the IOSSM status register.

IOSSM_TIMEOUT_MS

15000 milliseconds. io96b_mb_req() stops polling after this long.

TIMEOUT_5000MS

5000. TIMEOUT is set from this value.

TIMEOUT

Same value as TIMEOUT_5000MS. The memory-init poll divides it by 500.

IOSSM_STATUS_CAL_SUCCESS

Bit 0 of the IOSSM status register. io96b_cal_status() waits until it is set.

IOSSM_STATUS_CAL_FAIL

Bit 1 of the IOSSM status register. io96b_cal_status() waits until it is clear.

IOSSM_STATUS_CAL_BUSY

Bit 2 of the IOSSM status register.

IOSSM_STATUS_COMMAND_RESPONSE_READY

Value 1. The driver waits for this bit in the response status, then clears it.

Mailbox command register offsets

Byte offsets from the IO96B CSR base.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_STATUS_OFFSET

Offset 0x45C. Command response status.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_DATA_0_OFFSET

Offset 0x458. Response data word 0.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_DATA_1_OFFSET

Offset 0x454. Response data word 1.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_DATA_2_OFFSET

Offset 0x450. Response data word 2.

IOSSM_CMD_REQ_OFFSET

Offset 0x43C. Command request. The driver waits for this to read as zero before writing a command.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_0_OFFSET

Offset 0x438. Command parameter 0.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_1_OFFSET

Offset 0x434. Command parameter 1.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_2_OFFSET

Offset 0x430. Command parameter 2.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_3_OFFSET

Offset 0x42C. Command parameter 3.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_4_OFFSET

Offset 0x428. Command parameter 4.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_5_OFFSET

Offset 0x424. Command parameter 5.

IOSSM_CMD_PARAM_6_OFFSET

Offset 0x420. Command parameter 6.

IOSSM_STATUS_OFFSET

Offset 0x400. Calibration status. io96b_cal_status() reads it.

Short response data

The high half of a response status word.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_DATA_SHORT_MASK

Bits 31:16.

IOSSM_CMD_RESPONSE_DATA_SHORT

Bits 31:16 of data, shifted down into bits 15:0.

Interface counts and size

How many IO96B blocks and memory interfaces this header allows.

MAX_IO96B_SUPPORTED

Value 2.

MAX_MEM_INTERFACES_SUPPORTED

Value 2. io96b_mb_init() reads at most this many interfaces.

SZ_8

Value 8. get_mem_width_info() divides by this to turn gigabits into bytes.

GET_INLINE_ECC_HW_DDR_SIZE

size * 7 / 8. Bring-up uses this when inline ECC is on.

Memory interface info

Registers that identify each memory interface. io96b_mb_init() reads them.

IOSSM_MEM_INTF_INFO_0_OFFSET

Offset 0x200. Interface 0 info.

IOSSM_MEM_INTF_INFO_1_OFFSET

Offset 0x280. Interface 1 info.

INTF_IP_TYPE_MASK

Bits 31:29 of an interface info register. The IP type.

INTF_INSTANCE_ID_MASK

Bits 28:24 of an interface info register. The instance id.

ECC enable

Per-interface ECC enable registers.  The log text in the driver maps bits 1:0 to disabled (0), enabled with no correction or detection (1), correction without detection (2), or correction and detection (3). Bit 8 set is logged as in-line ECC.  Bit 8 clear is logged as out-of-band ECC.

IOSSM_ECC_ENABLE_INTF0_OFFSET

Offset 0x240. ECC enable for interface 0.

IOSSM_ECC_ENABLE_INTF1_OFFSET

Offset 0x2C0. ECC enable for interface 1.

INTF_ECC_ENABLE_TYPE_MASK

Bits 1:0. ecc_enable_status() treats 0 as ECC off.

INTF_ECC_TYPE_MASK

Bit 8. ecc_enable_status() stores a set bit as inline ECC.

Memory capacity

Registers that hold the size of each memory interface.  get_mem_width_info() reads bits 7:0 as a size in gigabits.

MAX_MEM_INTERFACE_SUPPORTED

Value 2. Length of the per-interface offset tables.

IOSSM_MEM_TOTAL_CAPACITY_INTF0_OFFSET

Offset 0x234. Total capacity for interface 0.

IOSSM_MEM_TOTAL_CAPACITY_INTF1_OFFSET

Offset 0x2B4. Total capacity for interface 1.

INTF_CAPACITY_GBITS_MASK

Bits 7:0 of a total-capacity register. Size in gigabits.

Memory init status

Status bit and registers polled while memory-init BIST runs.

INTF_BIST_STATUS_MASK

Bit 0. The out-of-band init path waits until this bit is set.

IOSSM_MEM_INIT_STATUS_INTF0_OFFSET

Offset 0x260. Memory init status for interface 0.

IOSSM_MEM_INIT_STATUS_INTF1_OFFSET

Offset 0x2E0. Memory init status for interface 1.

ECC error status registers

Offsets and the command value used while reading ECC errors.

IOSSM_ECC_ERR_STATUS_OFFSET

Offset 0x300. get_ecc_dbe_status() reads the error count from here.

IOSSM_ECC_ERR_DATA_START_OFFSET

Offset 0x310. First ECC error data word.

IOSSM_ECC_CLEAR_ERR_BUFFER

Value 0x0110. Written as the opcode that clears the ECC error buffer.

ECC error status fields

Fields in the ECC error status register.

ECC_ERR_COUNTER_MASK

Bits 15:0. Number of error entries.

ECC_ERR_OVERFLOW_MASK

Bits 31:16. Overflow field. The driver prints it.

ECC error data fields

Fields in one ECC error data word. The low address is a second word.

ECC_ERR_IP_TYPE_MASK

Bits 24:22.

ECC_ERR_INSTANCE_ID_MASK

Bits 21:17.

ECC_ERR_SOURCE_ID_MASK

Bits 16:10.

ECC_ERR_TYPE_MASK

Bits 9:6. Compared with ecc_error_type.

ECC_ERR_ADDR_UPPER_MASK

Bits 5:0. High part of the error address.

ECC_ERR_ADDR_LOWER_MASK

Bits 31:0. Mask for the low address word.

ECC error buffer

How many error entries the driver walks, and where it writes the clear.

MAX_ECC_ERR_COUNT

Value 16. The walk stops after 16 entries.

IOSSM_CONTROLLER_TRIGGER_OFFSET

Offset 0x300, the same address as the ECC error status register. The clear command is written here.

BIST start address

Fields in the BIST memory-init command. The inline ECC path fills them.

BIST_START_ADDR_SPACE_MASK

Bits 5:0. Receives log2 of the interface size.

BIST_START_ADDR_LOW_MASK

Bits 31:0 of the start address. The inline path writes 0.

BIST_START_ADDR_HIGH_MASK

Bits 37:32 of the start address. The inline path writes 0.

Types
iossm_mailbox_cmd_type

Command type placed in the command word, shifted left by 16.

CMD_NOP

Value 0.

CMD_GET_SYS_INFO

Value 1.

CMD_GET_MEM_INFO

Value 2. Sent with GET_MEM_TECHNOLOGY.

CMD_GET_MEM_CAL_INFO

Value 3.

CMD_TRIG_CONTROLLER_OP

Value 4. Sent for memory-init BIST and for the ECC buffer clear.

CMD_TRIG_MEM_CAL_OP

Value 5. Sent with TRIG_MEM_CAL and GET_MEM_CAL_STATUS.

ecc_error_type

Values stored in bits 9:6 of an ECC error data word.  get_ecc_dbe_status() treats five of them as double-bit errors.

SINGLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 0 (0b0000).

MULTIPLE_SINGLE_BIT_ERRORS

Value 1 (0b0001).

DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 2 (0b0010). Counted as a double-bit error.

MULTIPLE_DOUBLE_BIT_ERRORS

Value 3 (0b0011). Counted as a double-bit error.

SINGLE_BIT_ERROR_SCRUBBING

Value 8 (0b1000).

WRITE_LINK_SINGLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 9 (0b1001).

WRITE_LINK_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 10 (0b1010). Counted as a double-bit error.

READ_LINK_SINGLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 11 (0b1011).

READ_LINK_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 12 (0b1100). Counted as a double-bit error.

READ_MODIFY_WRITE_DOUBLE_BIT_ERROR

Value 13 (0b1101). Counted as a double-bit error.

iossm_mailbox_cmd_opcode

Command opcode placed in the low 16 bits of the command word.  Opcodes that this driver does not send are listed with their value only.

GET_MEM_INTF_INFO

Opcode 0x0001.

GET_MEM_TECHNOLOGY

Opcode 0x0002. get_mem_technology() sends this.

GET_MEMCLK_FREQ_KHZ

Opcode 0x0003.

GET_MEM_WIDTH_INFO

Opcode 0x0004.

ECC_ENABLE_SET

Opcode 0x0101.

ECC_ENABLE_STATUS

Opcode 0x0102.

ECC_INTERRUPT_STATUS

Opcode 0x0103.

ECC_INTERRUPT_ACK

Opcode 0x0104.

ECC_INTERRUPT_MASK

Opcode 0x0105.

ECC_WRITEBACK_ENABLE

Opcode 0x0106.

ECC_SCRUB_IN_PROGRESS_STATUS

Opcode 0x0201.

ECC_SCRUB_MODE_0_START

Opcode 0x0202.

ECC_SCRUB_MODE_1_START

Opcode 0x0203.

BIST_STANDARD_MODE_START

Opcode 0x0301.

BIST_RESULTS_STATUS

Opcode 0x0302.

BIST_MEM_INIT_START

Opcode 0x0303. Memory-init BIST sends this.

BIST_MEM_INIT_STATUS

Opcode 0x0304.

BIST_SET_DATA_PATTERN_UPPER

Opcode 0x0305.

BIST_SET_DATA_PATTERN_LOWER

Opcode 0x0306.

TRIG_MEM_CAL

Opcode 0x000a. trig_mem_cal() sends this to calibrate again.

GET_MEM_CAL_STATUS

Opcode 0x000b. trig_mem_cal() sends this to read calibration status.

io96b_mb_ctrl
struct
io96b_mb_ctrl

What the mailbox needs before it can address one IO96B.  io96b_mb_init() fills the IP type and instance id.  get_mem_width_info() fills the sizes.

num_mem_interface

How many interfaces on this IO96B have a non-zero IP type.

ip_type

IP type of each interface. Two entries.

ip_instance_id

Instance id of each interface. Two entries.

memory_size

Size of each interface, in bytes. Two entries.

io96b_mb_resp
struct
io96b_mb_resp

Words copied out of one mailbox response.

cmd_resp_status

Command response status word.

cmd_resp_data_0

Response data word 0.

cmd_resp_data_1

Response data word 1.

cmd_resp_data_2

Response data word 2.

io96b_instance
struct
io96b_instance

One IO96B instance.

io96b_csr_addr

CSR base address of this instance.

cal_status

true after io96b_cal_status() returns 0 for this instance.

mb_ctrl

Mailbox ids and sizes for this instance.

io96b_info
struct
io96b_info

Both IO96B instances, plus the totals bring-up keeps.

num_instance

How many instances are in use. 1, or 2 for dual-EMIF.

overall_cal_status

Set by init_mem_cal() when every instance succeeds, and by trig_mem_cal() when both instances have cal_status true.

ddr_type

DDR type name. get_mem_technology() sets it, starting from the name UNKNOWN.

ecc_status

true when ECC is enabled.

is_inline_ecc

true when ECC is on and bit 8 of the ECC enable register is set.

overall_size

Total DDR size, in bytes.

io96b_0

Instance 0.

io96b_1

Instance 1.

int io96b_mb_req(
phys_addr_t 
io96b_csr_addr,
uint32_t 
ip_type,
uint32_t 
instance_id,
uint32_t 
usr_cmd_type,
uint32_t 
usr_cmd_opcode,
uint32_t 
cmd_param_0,

cmd_param_1,

resp_data_len,
struct 
io96b_mb_resp 
*

)

Sends one mailbox command and copies the response.

Waits until the command request register is zero, writes each non-zero parameter 0 through 5, then writes the command word. Waits until the response-ready bit is set, copies the status and the requested data words, and clears the ready bit.

Parameters
io96b_csr_addr
phys_addr_t

IO96B CSR base. Register offsets are added to this.

ip_type
uint32_t

Shifted left by 29 in the command word.

instance_id
uint32_t

Shifted left by 24 in the command word.

usr_cmd_type
uint32_t

Shifted left by 16 in the command word.

usr_cmd_opcode
uint32_t

Stored in the low bits of the command word.

cmd_param_0
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 0 when not zero.

cmd_param_1
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 1 when not zero.

cmd_param_2
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 2 when not zero.

cmd_param_3
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 3 when not zero.

cmd_param_4
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 4 when not zero.

cmd_param_5
uint32_t

Written to parameter register 5 when not zero.

cmd_param_6
uint32_t

Not written. The parameter loop stops before this argument.

resp_data_len
uint32_t

How many response data words to read. Only words 0, 1, and 2 have registers.

resp
struct io96b_mb_resp*

Filled with the status word and the data words that were read.

Returns

0 when the response was read.  -ETIMEDOUT if the request register does not clear, or the ready bit does not set, within IOSSM_TIMEOUT_MS.

io96b_mb_init
void io96b_mb_init(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Reads the interface info registers and stores each IP type and instance id.

For every IO96B instance, reads interface info 0 and 1. An interface whose IP type is not zero is stored, and num_mem_interface grows by one.  Call this before a command that needs those ids.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

CSR addresses in. Interface ids and the interface count out.

Returns

Nothing.

io96b_cal_status
int io96b_cal_status(
phys_addr_t 
addr
)

Waits for one IO96B to finish calibration.  First waits until the calibration-fail bit is clear, then waits until the calibration-success bit is set. Each wait lasts 15000 milliseconds.

Parameters
addr
phys_addr_t

IO96B CSR base address.

Returns

0 when calibration succeeded.  -EBUSY if the fail bit stays set, or the success bit does not set.

init_mem_cal
void init_mem_cal(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Checks calibration on every IO96B instance.  Stores each result in cal_status. Sets overall_cal_status true only when every instance succeeds.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Instances to check. The status fields are written.

Returns

Nothing.

trig_mem_cal
int trig_mem_cal(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Runs calibration again on instances that failed the first check.

Skips an instance whose cal_status is already true. For each of the two interfaces, reads the low 3 bits of the calibration status. While that value is 2 or more, sends TRIG_MEM_CAL and reads the status again, up to 3 times. Sets overall_cal_status when both io96b_0 and io96b_1 have cal_status true.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Instances to recalibrate.

Returns

0 when each failed interface reaches a status below 2.  -ETIMEDOUT if a mailbox wait expires.  -EIO if an interface is still not calibrated after 3 tries.

get_mem_technology
int get_mem_technology(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Reads the DDR type from each memory interface.

Sends GET_MEM_TECHNOLOGY with command type CMD_GET_MEM_INFO. The low 3 bits of the short response pick a name from the DDR type list, and that name is stored in ddr_type. A later interface that reports a different name is an error.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Receives ddr_type.

Returns

0 on success.  -ETIMEDOUT if a mailbox wait expires.  -EINVAL if the type id is greater than 6.  -ENOEXEC if two interfaces report different types.

get_mem_width_info
int get_mem_width_info(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Reads the size of each memory interface from the capacity registers.

Bits 7:0 are a size in gigabits. The function turns that into bytes, stores it in memory_size, and adds the interfaces into overall_size.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Receives memory_size and overall_size.

Returns

0 on success.  -ENOEXEC if one instance size is 0, or the total size is 0.

ecc_enable_status
int ecc_enable_status(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Reads whether ECC is enabled, and whether it is inline ECC.

A non-zero value in bits 1:0 sets ecc_status. On the first interface that has ECC on, bit 8 is stored in is_inline_ecc. Every interface must report the same ecc_status.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Receives ecc_status and is_inline_ecc.

Returns

0 on success.  -ENOEXEC if two interfaces disagree.

bist_mem_init_start
int bist_mem_init_start(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Starts memory-init BIST on every interface.  Calls inline_ecc_bist_mem_init() when is_inline_ecc is true.  Otherwise calls out_of_band_ecc_bist_mem_init().

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

ECC mode and the interfaces to initialize.

Returns

0 on success, or the error returned by the selected init path.

get_ecc_dbe_status
bool get_ecc_dbe_status(
struct 
io96b_info 
*
io96b_ctrl
)

Reports whether any stored ECC error is a double-bit error.

Reads the error count. When the count is not zero, walks that many entries, up to MAX_ECC_ERR_COUNT, and tests each type. Then writes the command that clears the error buffer.

Parameters
io96b_ctrl
struct io96b_info*

Instances to read.

Returns

true if a double-bit error type was seen, otherwise false.
